questions.rawText:
250kg of feed water enters the boiler at a temperature of 27°C. steam at a pressure of 1.5 N/mm2
leaves the boiler as 17.5% wet and enters the super heater where it is superheated to a
temperature of 310°C. Further, from the super heater if the steam is led to a heat exchanger for
process heating where it loses 65.8% of enthalpy, determine the following;
i) Total heat supplied to water in the boiler
ii) Total heat supplied steam in the superheater.
iii) The condition and related parameter of the steam at the exit point of heat exchanger.
Assume the specific heat of water as 4.187 kJ/KgK and that of super-heated steam as 2.25
kJ/KgsK.

Boilers A and B supply steam to a common pipeline at a ratio of 7:3 at a pressure of 185 N/cm2. The
steam from boiler-A is at temperature 280⁰C, while the condition of steam from boiler-B is unknown.
The steam in the common pipeline is 18% wet at 1.85MPa. The calorific value of fuel supplied to
boiler-A is 39.5MJ/kg and boiler-B is 37.75MJ/kg. Compute the condition of steam supplied by
boiler-B.
Assume specific heat of superheated steam and saturated water as 2.25 kJ/kgK and 4.187 kJ/kgK
respectively.
Explain any three boiler accessories, that enhance the efficiency of a boiler.

A belt drive is used to transmit the power from a DC motor to the head-stock in a lathe machine. DC
motor shaft rotates at a constant speed of 1200 rpm. The centre distance between the shaft of the
belt drive is 1.85 m. The speed reduction ratio is 3.5, and the angle of contact on the smaller pulley
is 4.15 radians. The larger pulley has a diameter of 80 cm. The initial belt tension is 850 N and the
coefficient of friction is 0.25, sketch the arrangement and calculate the following:
i) Power transmitted in the belt drive
ii) Length of the belt drive
iii) Width of the belt drive, if permissible tension in the belt drive is 8kN per meter width of the belt.

The following gear wheels are available to form a compound gear train. Sketch the arrangement of
the gear train using four shafts, to obtain highest velocity ratio at the output shaft and calculate the
same. Also mention the conditions used to achieve the condition.

Comment on the following:
i. Life of the belt in cross belt drive is lower as compared with open belt drive.
ii. Friction is an helpful agent in case of transmission of power using belts
iii. Contact area of the belt on the pulley influences the power transmission.

Illustrating thermodynamic events explain working of an IC engine that directly admits the charge
and operates with a compression ratio of 18:1.

The following observations were recorded during a test on a 4-stroke engine. Bore=15cm, Stroke
=20cm, Cam Shaft Speed= 250 rpm, Mean effective pressure= 8bar, Fuel consumption=
0.0013kg/sec, Calorific value of the fuel= 43900kJ/kg. Determine the indicated thermal efficiency.

Give suitable reasons for the following:
i) For the same capacity four stroke engines are heavy and bulkier as compared to two stroke
engines.
ii) Two stroke petrol engines generate more pollution as compared to four stroke petrol engines.
iii) Multi cylinder engine requires a lighter flywheel as compared to a single cylinder engine.

A simple refrigerant cycle uses R134a. The evaporator and condenser pressures are 0.234 MPa
and 1.01MPa respectively. After compression the refrigerant is superheated by 10 °C Determine:
i) COP of the cycle
ii) Refrigerating capacity if the mass flow is 7 kg/min.
Assume that at the exit of the evaporator the refrigerant is dry.

Write a short note on:
i) Unit of refrigeration
ii) Coefficient of Performance

Write the functions of the following lathe parts:
i. Chuck
ii. Tailstock
iii. Bed
Explain Clausius statement and Kelvin Plank statement.
List and explain any 3 advantages of CNC machines.

What are the various stages in producing a part using additive manufacturing technique.
-----End-----

The steam is initially available at a pressure of 9 bar and dryness 0.98. Find the final quality and
temperature of steam at each of the following operations:
(i) When steam loses 50 kJ/Kg at constant pressure
(ii) When steam receives 150 kJ/Kg at constant pressure

A chemical company planning to install a coal fired boiler in its plant for process heating is weighing
different technical options due to investment constraints. The steam generation capacity required is
5000 kg per hour at a pressure of 0.56 MPa and at a temperature of 220 °C. The feed water is
available from a nearby reservoir at an average temperature of 30 °C. The coal consumption is
1500 kg/hr, having a calorific value of 24 MJ/kg. Assess the improvement in boiler efficiency if the
following accessories are used.
i) Economizer which will increase the feed water temperature by 58 °C and reduce the coal
consumption by 14%.
ii) Air Preheater which will reduce the coal consumption by 20%.
iii) Both Economizer and Air Preheater whose combined effect will reduce the coal consumption by
30%.

i. Explain the boiler mounting used when the water level in the boiler falls dangerously low.
ii. A power plant needs a boiler to run its turbines and needs to provide steam generation at a faster
rate. Which type of boiler will be most suitable and why?
iii. Explain the significance of inclined water tubes in Babcock and Wilcox boiler

A belt drive transmitting power between two pulleys which are 2 meters apart with a speed
reduction ratio of 4 has an angle of contact of 3.81 radians. The diameter of the larger pulley is 100
cm and the driver pulley runs at 400 rpm. The initial tension in the belt is 0.95 kN and coefficient of
friction is 0.28. Calculate the length of the belt, power transmitted and width of the belt if the
permissible tension per meter width of the belt is 10 kN.

A compound gear train consists of six gear wheels A, B, C, D, E & F. A is the driver gear and F is
the driven gear having 100 and 16 teeth respectively. Gear A meshes with gear B having 60 teeth
and gear B & C are integral and concentric. Gear C has 80 teeth and meshes with gear D having
100 teeth. Gears D & E are mounted on the same shaft and gear E have 50 teeth meshes with gear
F. Sketch the arrangement of gears and determine the velocity ratio.

Suggest and explain with sketch an arrangement when four different speeds are required on the
driven shaft.

Illustrating piston movements explain working of an IC engine that indirectly admits the charge and
operates with a compression ratio of 9:1.

The following data refers to a twin cylinder IC engine generating power in every revolution of the
crank shaft. Total stroke volume: 1.5litres, Number of cycles per revolution: 1800, Mean effective
pressure: 0.32 MPa, Fuel consumption: 0.00675m3/h, Density of fuel: 800kg/m3, Calorific value of
the fuel: 45000kJ/kg. Determine indicated thermal efficiency?

How do four stroke petrol engines differ from four stroke diesel engines in terms of construction and
working? List 6 points.
List and explain any four parts of a Lathe machine.
With a neat sketch explain the counterboring operation performed on a drilling machine.

Explain in detail the working principle of an arc welding process that uses a non consumable
electrode.
List and explain the common casting defects found in sand casting process.

Explain how computer control has enhanced productivity and accuracy in CNC machines compared
to NC machines.

What is additive manufacturing? Explain with suitable example.
-----End-----

questions.rawText:
500kg of wet steam at a pressure of 0.6 MPa is generated in a boiler per hour. The temperature of
feed water is 20°C and the total amount of heat added in the boiler is 1236MJ/h. The steam from
the boiler enters the super heater after a heat loss of 300kJ/kg, where its temperature is to be
raised to 200°C. Determine
(i) Dryness fraction of the steam at the entry point of the super heater?
(ii) Heat absorbed per hour in the super heater?

A gas-fired boiler produces superheated steam at 100 bar from feedwater at 45 °C, with a steam
flow rate of 12 kg/s. Fuel gas is burned at a rate of 1.5 tons per hour, having a GCV of 46 MJ/kg,
and the boiler efficiency is 88%. Find the condition of steam produced.

Classify boilers based on the following criteria:
i) Flow of water and hot gases
ii) Circulation of water
iii) Axis of the shell

Power is transmitted between two shafts, 4 meters apart, using two pulleys, both rotating in
counterclockwise directions, with a velocity ratio of unity. The length of the belt is 11.142m, and the
coefficient of friction is 0.3. Determine the size of the two pulleys and the tensions on both sides of
the belt drive if the initial tension is 0.75KN.

A simple gear train as shown in Figure, has four gears namely A, B, C and D. Gear A is driver gear
and D gear is driven gear. Gears B and C are intermediate gears. Driving gear A rotates
anticlockwise direction with a speed of 300 rpm. The number of teeth on gears A, B, C and D are
30, 90, 60 and 120, respectively. Determine
(i) the speed of the driven gear, and (ii) the speed of rotations of intermediate gears, (iii) the velocity
ratio of gear trains.

Explain, with a neat diagram, the arrangement and operation of a pulley system designed to
transmit motion to the follower shaft at various speeds.

Illustrating thermodynamic events explain working of an IC engine that directly admits the charge
and operates with a compression ratio of 9:1.

The following observations were recorded during a test on an IC engine. Net load on the brake
drum = 36kg, Cam Shaft Speed= 250 rpm, Fuel consumption= 0.003kg/sec, Diameter of the brake
drum = 2m, Calorific value of the fuel= 43900kJ/kg. Determine the Brake Thermal Efficiency and
Brake specific fuel consumption.

Give suitable reasons for the following:
i) Crank shaft speed is double that of cam shaft speed.
ii) Piston rings are an essential component of an internal combustion engine.
iii) Four stroke engines require a heavier flywheel as compared to two stroke engines.

A vapour compression refrigerator uses tetrafluoroethane (R134a) as a refrigerant and operates
between 10.1 bar and 2 bar. The vapour is superheated before entering and after exiting the
compressor by 7.5⁰C and 18⁰C respectively. Compute the following:
i. Coefficient of performance of the system
ii. Mass flow rate of the refrigerant in the system, if the capacity of the system is 14 TR.
With a neat sketch, explain the working principle of a domestic refrigerator.
With a neat sketch, explain any three lathe operations.
Explain the various modes of heat transfer with suitable examples.
State and explain any three features of CNC control system.

Explain the step-by-step procedure for producing an object using additive manufacturing method.
-----End-----

Steam is generated in a boiler at a pressure of 10 bar. The steam leaving the boiler initially has a
specific enthalpy of 2100 kJ/kg. It is then passed through a superheater, where it is further heated
at the same pressure until its enthalpy reaches 2700 kJ/kg.
i) Determine the initial quality of the steam leaving the boiler and the quality after partial
superheating.
ii) Alternatively, if the steam needs to be further heated in the superheater to become superheated
by 10°C, calculate the additional heat required per kilogram of steam from the boiler exit.

A steam boiler produces 6000kg of steam per hour at a pressure of 0.56 MPa and at a temperature
of 230ºC. The feed water temperature is 25ºC. The mass of fuel consumption is 20 Kg/min., having
a calorific value of 24MJ/kg. Assess the improvement in boiler efficiency if the following accessories
are used.
i) Economizer will increase the feed water temperature to 63ºC and reduce coal consumption by
10%.
ii) Air Preheater which will reduce coal consumption by 22%.
Compare the functions of blow-off cock and fusible plug.

A mechanical drive system in a mining plant uses a flat belt drive to transmit power between two
parallel shafts rotating in opposite directions. The driver pulley has a diameter of 300 mm while the
driven pulley on the output shaft runs at 250 rpm. The centre distance between the two pulleys is
800 mm. The initial belt tension is 1500 N, and the coefficient of friction between the belt and pulley
surface is 0.28.
Determine the following:
i) The tensions in the tight side and slack side of the belt.
ii) The power transmitted by the belt.
iii) The length of the belt required for this belt drive.Assume the system provides a speed reduction
ratio of 3:2.

A compound gear train consists of six gears - A, B, C, D, E, and F. Gear A is the driver, and gear F
is the driven gear, having 80 teeth and 18 teeth, respectively. Gear A meshes with gear B, and
gears B and C are mounted on the same shaft. Gear C, which has 60 teeth, meshes with gear D.
Gears D and E are mounted on another common shaft, and gear E finally meshes with gear F. The
overall velocity ratio from gear A to gear F is 64. It is also given that the velocity ratio between A and
B is equal to the velocity ratio between C and D, and equal to the velocity ratio between E and F.
Determine:
i) The number of teeth on gears B, D, and E.
ii) The centre distance between the driver and driven shafts, if the circular pitch of all gears is 2.5π
mm.
Explain the effect of creep and slip on the velocity ratio of belt drives.

Illustrating thermodynamic events and piston movements, explain the working of an IC engine fitted
with a heavier flywheel and operating on isochoric heat addition principle.

The total clearance volume of a 6-cylinder internal combustion engine is 300cc. Determine the bore
and stroke of each cylinder if the two are equal for each cylinder and the compression ratio is 10:1.
Also calculate power output per liter of cylinder stroke volume if the total power output of the engine
is 30 kW.
What criteria are used to classify internal combustion engines?

A long, gradual external taper is to be produced on a mild steel shaft whose length exceeds the
compound rest travel. Identify the most suitable taper turning method, justify your choice, and
explain its working principle with a neat sketch.

A component requires a smooth, accurately sized hole with internal threads to fit a conical head
screw.
List the sequence of machining operations that need to be performed on a drilling machine to obtain
the required hole, and briefly state the purpose of each operation.

Two thin steel sheets used in automobile body fabrication are to be joined quickly without using
filler material. Identify the welding process and explain the same.

Give reason for the following:
i) Gate cutting is done to create a passage through which molten metal enters the mold cavity.
ii) Patterns are made slightly larger than the final casting dimensions.
iii) Molding sand must have sufficient cohesiveness and proper moisture content.
iv) Patterns are provided with a draft or taper.
Explain the role of industrial robots in processing and material handling applications.

Justify the following statements:
P
2
i) Automation helps increase labour productivity
ii) Additive manufacturing helps increase customization in parts being manufactured
iii) CNC machines reduces manufacturing lead time

A boiler produces 1200 kg of steam per hour at a pressure of 12 bar and a dryness fraction of 0.85.
This steam is then passed through a superheater, where its degree of super heat is 150°C above
the saturation temperature. The feedwater supplied to the boiler is at a temperature of 40°C.
Determine:
a) The total amount of heat added per hour in the boiler to convert the feedwater into wet steam.
b) The total heat energy absorbed per hour in the superheater to raise the temperature of the
steam.
(Assume Cp= 4.18 kJ/kgK & Csup = 2.25 kJ/kgK)

A boiler installed in a food processing unit generates 0.85 tons of steam per day at a pressure of 5
bar with a dryness fraction of 0.9. The boiler is equipped with an economizer, which preheats the
feedwater to 85°C before it enters the boiler. It is fired using a mixture of biogas and sugarcane
bagasse in equal proportions by mass. Calorific value (GCV) of Biogas = 19,500 kJ/kg
And Sugarcane bagasse = 8,500 kJ/kg. If the boiler operates with an average thermal efficiency of
80%, calculate the daily consumption of biogas and sugarcane bagasse.
Assume specific heat of water and superheated steam as 4.187kJ/kg K and 2.25kJ/kg k
respectively.

Compare the functions of an economizer and an air preheater. How do they complement each other
in a boiler system?

An open belt drive 10 cm wide connects two pulleys mounted on parallel shafts 2.5m apart. The
diameter of driving pulley is 45cm and that of follower is 30 cm. If permissible pull in the belt is
limited to 180N/cm of width, find the power that can be transmitted when driving pulley is rotating at
120 rpm also calculate the length of the belt. Assume co-efficient of friction is 0.3.

The shaft from a prime mover consists of six gear wheels A, B, C, D, E & F. Gears B and C are
compound gears, as are gears D and E. Gear E meshes with gear F and gear A meshes with gear
B which is mounted on the driven shaft. The number of teeth on gears A, B, C, D, E, and F are 30,
45, 60, 72, 84, and 96 respectively. Gear A which rotates at 200rpm in anticlockwise direction.
Sketch the arrangement and determine the speed of driven gear and calculate the centre distance
Page 1 of 3
between the driver and driven shafts if the module of gears is 2π mm.
Explain the function of fast and loose pulley with a neat sketch.

With suitable illustrations explain how the reciprocating motion is transformed into the rotary motion
in a prime mover that indirectly admits the charge and operates on the principle of isobaric heat
addition?

The following data refers to a twin cylinder I C Engine:
Cylinder diameter = 150mm, Stroke length = 200mm, Total cam shaft revolutions/hour = 12000,
Mean effective pressure = 0.64MPa, Fuel consumption = 10litres/hour, Calorific value of the fuel =
45000kJ/kg, Density of the fuel = 780kg/m3, Determine the indicated thermal efficiency.
How do two stroke petrol engines differ from two stroke diesel engines? List any six points.

Suggest a suitable lathe operation which is used to produce helical grooves on a cylindrical
workpiece. Explain the same with the help of a neat sketch.

Suggest and explain, with the help of a neat sketch, suitable drilling operations that can be
performed to accomplish the following:
i) Flat seating surface for a washer
ii) Groove for a bolt head

Sketch and explain different types of gas flames that can be used in oxy-acetylene welding
process.

Explain the significance of the following pattern allowances:
i) Machining allowance
ii) Shrinkage allowance
iii) Rapping allowance
iv) Draft allowance
List down any six reasons for employing automation in production.

How do the following components of an NC machine contribute to making the system unreliable:
Punched tape, control unit and tape reader.
